information: This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/) as the Southeast [Regional Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) for 2023. Residents of the following states/territories are eligible for the title of Southeast Champion: Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, Puerto Rico, South Carolina, Tennessee, and US Virgin Islands.
